violated_contract: A pipeline step that is launched as a subprocess must do its work when launched, and a missing output must not be indistinguishable from a skipped one. pull_vendor_balance.py defined pull() but had no command-line entry point, so the daily finops job's balance step exited 0 writing no artifact and the loader treated the missing artifact as dark; omi_finops.vendor_balance_snapshot was never created and the Omi TV Soniox line stayed on a dated constant for weeks.
canonical_prevention: Every finops pull script has a main() guarded by __main__, and a subprocess test runs it the way the job does and asserts it leaves an artifact (ready or skipped with a reason).
